enabled.title: Enable Sound Physics
enabled.description: Master switch for all sound effects

attenuation_factor.title: Attenuation Factor
attenuation_factor.description: How quiet distant sounds become. 1.0 = physically correct. Lower = louder distant sounds

reverb_brightness.title: Reverb Brightness
reverb_brightness.description: High frequency content of reverb (0 = dark, 1 = bright)

max_occlusion.title: Max Occlusion
max_occlusion.description: Maximum amount of sound that can be blocked by walls

occlusion_variation.title: Occlusion Variation
occlusion_variation.description: Use multiple rays for more accurate occlusion instead of single ray

environment_evaluation_ray_count.title: Environment Ray Count
environment_evaluation_ray_count.description: Number of rays used to evaluate the environment (higher = better quality, more lag)

environment_evaluation_ray_bounces.title: Ray Bounces
environment_evaluation_ray_bounces.description: How many times rays bounce for reverb calculation

max_sound_processing_distance.title: Max Processing Distance
max_sound_processing_distance.description: Sounds farther than this (blocks) will not be processed

sound_direction_evaluation.title: Sound Direction Evaluation
sound_direction_evaluation.description: Try to calculate where the sound should come from based on reflections

update_moving_sounds.title: Update Moving Sounds
update_moving_sounds.description: Frequently re-evaluate long sounds (music discs, etc.)

sound_update_interval.title: Sound Update Interval
sound_update_interval.description: Ticks between re-evaluation of moving sounds (only if Update Moving Sounds is on)
